## Page / cycle
`meta/cycles/YYYY-MM-DD-<page>/`

## Checklist (see `meta/review-checklist.md`)
- [ ] Copy approved in `copy.md` and matches word for word
- [ ] Matches the Paper design (desktop and mobile)
- [ ] Mobile checked (390)
- [ ] Links work, CTA fires its analytics event
- [ ] SEO title, description, and OG image set
- [ ] `review.md` written by a separate reviewer agent; all issues fixed
- [ ] `summary.md` updated
- [ ] Final screenshots added
